walsinShareBlock.2022ClosingTreatment: The 88,729 shares were separate from the 1,371,729-share block disposed to ECP. Walsin Lihwa Holdings contributed the 88,729 New Leaf shares to its newly established wholly owned subsidiary Walsin America as an intra-group restructuring allocation.
walsinShareBlock.laterDispositionEvidence: Walsin's October 12, 2022 supplemental material-information disclosure identifies exactly 88,729 common shares of 2022 Solar Development, Inc., renamed New Leaf Energy, Inc., as the shares sold back by Walsin America. It reports approximately US$175.05 per share and approximately US$15.532 million of consideration. The preceding May 24 disclosure stated that Walsin America would sell all of its shares back to 2022 Solar Development and that actual quantity and unit price would follow after completion.
walsinShareBlock.currentStatusBasis: The completed sale-back of the entire exact-match block is affirmative evidence that Walsin America ceased to own the shares. Whether New Leaf cancelled the repurchased shares or held them as treasury shares does not restore ownership to Walsin America. Later Walsin omissions are corroborative only, not the primary basis.

searchedButNotFound: No later Walsin announcement or filing showing that Walsin America reacquired New Leaf shares after the October 2022 sale-back.
No credible post-2022 sale or transfer of the New Leaf platform to another sponsor.
No public record of whether New Leaf cancelled the repurchased 88,729 shares or held them as treasury shares.
rationale: The affirmative-disposition threshold is met. The audited report explains the initial 88,729-share contribution to Walsin America, while the issuer-disclosure sequence states that Walsin America would sell all of those shares back to New Leaf and later reports the exact completed 88,729-share transaction. Later omissions only corroborate that affirmative disposition evidence.
unresolvedQuestions: The issuer's post-repurchase cancellation or treasury-share treatment is not publicly disclosed; either treatment leaves Walsin America without ownership.
The exact current ECP ownership percentage, legal holding vehicle and any management co-investment are not publicly disclosed.
